judgement.reason: Authentik is a single-image web app on PostgreSQL, and its local media storage can be moved to S3, so a contained change is enough.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: volume ./data:/data (lifecycle/container/compose.yml server), volume ./custom-templates:/templates (lifecycle/container/compose.yml server), volume ./data:/data (lifecycle/container/compose.yml worker), volume ./custom-templates:/templates (lifecycle/container/compose.yml worker)
reviews.reason: The compose file mounts ./data and ./custom-templates into the server and worker, and none of the shown lines prove that S3 or the database replaces that data (authentik stores media files in /data by default), so the finding stands.
